raw_text:
Sarah Johnson
Senior Full Stack Developer

Contact:
Email: sarah.johnson@email.com
Phone: +1-555-0123
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/sarahjohnson
GitHub: https://github.com/sarah-codes
Location: San Francisco, CA

Professional Summary:
Highly skilled Full Stack Developer with 7+ years of experience building scalable web applications. Expert in React, Node.js, Python, and cloud technologies. Passionate about clean code, system design, and mentoring junior developers.

Work Experience:

Senior Full Stack Developer | Tech Innovations Inc.
San Francisco, CA | March 2021 - Present
- Led development of microservices architecture serving 2M+ users
- Reduced API response time by 60% through optimization and caching strategies
- Mentored team of 5 junior developers, improving code quality by 40%
- Implemented CI/CD pipeline reducing deployment time from 2 hours to 15 minutes
- Tech Stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda)

Full Stack Developer | StartupHub
San Francisco, CA | June 2018 - February 2021
- Built real-time collaboration platform using WebSockets and React
- Designed and implemented RESTful APIs handling 500K requests/day
- Integrated third-party payment systems (Stripe, PayPal)
- Improved test coverage from 30% to 85% using Jest and Cypress
- Tech Stack: React, Redux, Express.js, MongoDB, Docker, AWS

Software Engineer | Digital Solutions Corp.
New York, NY | July 2016 - May 2018
- Developed customer-facing web applications using Angular and Spring Boot
- Implemented responsive designs improving mobile user engagement by 45%
- Collaborated with UX team to redesign admin dashboard
- Tech Stack: Angular, Java Spring Boot, MySQL, Jenkins

Education:

Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
Stanford University | 2012-2016
GPA: 3.8/4.0

Technical Skills:
- Frontend: React, TypeScript, Redux, Next.js, Vue.js, HTML5, CSS3, Tailwind
- Backend: Node.js, Express, Python, Django, Flask, Java Spring Boot
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis
- Cloud & DevOps: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Jenkins
- Testing: Jest, Mocha, Cypress, Pytest
- Tools: Git, GitHub Actions, Webpack, Vite

Projects:

1. E-Commerce Platform (2023)
   - Built full-featured e-commerce platform with payment integration
   - Implemented cart management, order tracking, and admin dashboard
   - Technologies: Next.js, Node.js, Stripe API, PostgreSQL
   - Result: Processed $500K in transactions in first 6 months

2. Real-Time Analytics Dashboard (2022)
   - Created real-time data visualization platform for business metrics
   - Implemented WebSocket connections for live updates
   - Technologies: React, D3.js, Socket.io, Node.js, InfluxDB
   - Result: Reduced reporting time from days to real-time

3. Task Management SaaS (2021)
   - Developed collaborative task management application
   - Features: Real-time collaboration, notifications, file attachments
   - Technologies: React, Express, MongoDB, AWS S3
   - Result: 10K+ active users within first year

Certifications:
- AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (2023)
- MongoDB Certified Developer (2022)

Achievements:
- Featured speaker at React Conference 2023
- Open source contributor with 2K+ GitHub stars across projects
- Hackathon winner - Best Web Application (2022)
